rules identity
  | // @explain fold
  | .decl has_chosen(referent: symbol)
  | has_chosen(a) :- chosen(a, r).
  | // @explain on_demand
  | .decl rank_conflict(a: symbol, b: symbol)
  | rank_conflict(a, b) :- before(a, b), rank(a, x), rank(b, y), x >= y.

lines: rank_conflict(a, b) :- before(a, b), rank(a, x), rank(b, y), x >= y.
